# List of images to build in GitHub Actions
# Format: device/distro/services or device/services (1st distro default)
#
# Examples:
#   rpi4/default+emulations              # RPi4 with default distro + emulation services
#   rpi4/debian/default+emulations       # Same, explicit distro
#   switch/default+emulations+desktop    # Switch with desktop
#
# See ./bin/autobuild --list-images for available devices/services

# Raspberry Pi 5
rpi5/default+emulations

# Nintendo Switch
